summary: Two snowmobilers became stuck on Buffalo Pass in Jackson County near Grizzly Lake, one with a minor injury. Jackson County SAR requested RCSAR assistance given the location near the Routt County border. A team of snowmobilers and skiers navigated nearly 3 miles in dense fog and blowing snow by compass to reach them, then assisted both snowmobilers back to Fish Creek Reservoir, where a tracked UTV returned them to the trailhead. The RCSAR team was out of the field at 2:00 a.m.
responding_agency: Jackson County Search and Rescue; Routt County Search and Rescue (assist)
